summary: Verified the build.sh uv compatibility fix against the reported unsupported-sync class, the local uv-sync failure class, the prepared-workspace path, web smoke startup, Python tests, frontend checks, and AppForge quality gates.
test_commands: bash -c 'uv() { printf "error: unrecognized subcommand '\''sync'\''\n" >&2; return 2; }; export -f uv; APPFORGE_SKIP_FRONTEND_BUILD=1 ./build.sh --check'

results.evidence: APPFORGE_SKIP_FRONTEND_BUILD=1 ./build.sh --check first showed the sandboxed uv cache failure, then fell back to pip editable install without build isolation and completed.
A shell-exported uv function returning unrecognized subcommand 'sync' caused build.sh to skip uv sync and complete through pip fallback.
APPFORGE_SKIP_INSTALL=1 APPFORGE_SKIP_FRONTEND_BUILD=1 APPFORGE_WEB_PORT=8799 ./build.sh --smoke returned HTTP success for /api/health and /, then stopped its web pid.
.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q returned 24 passed with one existing Starlette TestClient deprecation warning.
npm --prefix frontend run typecheck and npm --prefix frontend run build returned success; Vite rebuilt the packaged assets.
appforge tool run run_tests executed .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q and returned success.
appforge tool run run_build executed .venv/bin/python -m build --no-isolation and returned success.

acceptance_results.evidence: uv sync remains preferred, unsupported uv sync falls back to pip, uv sync runtime failure falls back to pip, and .venv/bin/appforge remains executable after setup.
--smoke reached both the health endpoint and web UI endpoint on 127.0.0.1:8799 and cleaned up the child web process.
bash syntax, prepared --check, fallback --check, and no-browser smoke all returned success.
pytest, frontend typecheck, frontend build, and AppForge run_build all passed after the patch.
The launcher reconciles a uv-created venv missing pip by bootstrapping pip, then performs editable install.
Each invocation attempts uv sync at most once, then falls back to one pip install path before exiting or continuing.

coverage: The reported uv subcommand compatibility failure, the local uv execution failure, prepared-workspace skip mode, web smoke convergence, Python package tests, frontend TypeScript/build, and AppForge required test/build gates were covered. No live external LLM provider call was needed or attempted.
failures: Pre-fix reproduction: APPFORGE_SKIP_FRONTEND_BUILD=1 ./build.sh --check failed because uv sync could not access /Users/lee/Library/Caches/uv under sandbox restrictions.
Intermediate failure: the first pip fallback assumed pip existed in a uv-created .venv; fixed by bootstrapping pip with ensurepip.

Intermediate failure: pip editable install with build isolation tried to download setuptools in a network-restricted run; fixed by using --no-build-isolation when setuptools and wheel are already available.
manual_checks: Reviewed build.sh fallback branch ordering for unsupported uv, failed uv sync, missing pip, missing build backend packages, and final .venv/bin/appforge validation.
Reviewed README.md, docs/WEB_APP.md, and CHANGELOG.md text for uv-or-pip fallback accuracy.
